all.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

all.title: Amaran
all.overview: A heroic true story of Major Mukund Varadarajan, an Indian Army officer who displayed extraordinary bravery during a counterterrorism mission in Kashmir’s Shopian district. The film captures his courage in protecting his nation and the devotion of his wife Indhu Rebecaa Varghese.

all.title: Maharaja
all.overview: A barber seeks vengeance after his home is burglarized, cryptically telling police his "Lakshmi" has been taken, leaving them uncertain if it's a person or object, jeer at his request until they learn what they're really looking for.

all.title: Pechi
all.overview: Five young trekkers and their tour guide embark on a weekend adventure in the Kollimalai hills. Despite warnings, they venture into a restricted area, unknowingly entering the domain of a malevolent spirit, which is hell bent on wreaking havoc in their lives. Did they survive the relentless onslaught and harrowing encounter with the supernatural force in the haunted woods?

all.title: Black Gold
all.overview: “Black Gold” is a visually striking film directed by a Japanese filmmaker, blending a minimalist aesthetic with the natural beauty of rural India – a true visual feast for cinephiles. Every detail is crafted with precision, reflecting a uniquely Japanese perspective.

all.title: Joshua Imai Pol Kaakha
all.overview: A contract killer seeking a different profession is assigned to protect a high-profile speaker.

all.title: Meiyazhagan
all.overview: Twenty-two years after losing his home, Arulmozhi Varman returns to his native Thanjavur to attend his cousin's wedding. Amidst the celebrations, Arul is reintroduced to an upbeat man whom he cannot recall. With the help of the unknown man, Arul reconnects with his past.

all.title: Crime Reel
all.overview: An innocent girl gets addicted to Instagram reels and social media. She starts participating in all trends, she starts admiring of become a heroine.

all.title: Kanguva
all.overview: A bounty hunter in present day, learns about his previous life as a legendary warrior, when fate unites him with a mutant kid.

all.title: Election
all.overview: Nadarasan, uninterested in politics, runs for panchayat leader to honor his father. As he delves into the murky world of election politics, he faces violence, rivalry, and betrayals.

all.title: E-Mail
all.overview: When an Online Game rakes in money, it excites and becomes an addiction. But when its high time and you are at the point of no return where you realise that it isn't a mere Game but a Scam which eventually threatens and becomes a question of Life & Death of your loved one - how far will you go? At what cost?

all.title: Virundhu
all.overview: Famous businessman John Kalathil dies by suicide. 6 months later, his wife Elizabeth meets a tragic accident. On her deathbed, she tasks auto driver Hemand to pass a secret to Comrade Balettan.

all.title: The Greatest of All Time
all.overview: A once decorated member of the Special Anti-Terrorism Squad (SATS) is called back into action by his former colleagues for an important mission, setting him on a dangerous collision course with his own past.

all.title: Matchbox the Movie
all.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

all.title: Devara: Part 1
all.overview: A mighty warrior takes a stand against the criminal deeds of his village, while his mild-mannered son grows up to walk his own path.

all.title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
all.overview: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

all.title: Kattalan
all.overview: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

hero_slides.title: OM: Operation Mole
hero_slides.overview: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

hero_slides.title: The Odyssey
hero_slides.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

hero_slides.title: The Beast
hero_slides.overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

hero_slides.title: Avengers: Doomsday
hero_slides.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

hero_slides.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
hero_slides.nativeTitle: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
hero_slides.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

hero_slides.title: Other Mommy
hero_slides.overview: 7-year-old Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

hero_slides.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
hero_slides.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

hero_slides.title: Ebenezer
hero_slides.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

hero_slides.title: Resident Evil
hero_slides.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

hero_slides.title: Heart of the Beast
hero_slides.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
